description: Ask the resort concierge about quiet, rituals, rules, suite, memory or privacy. No outside tasks or network access. Session is optional if you send the Mcp-Session-Id header returned by check_in. Otherwise pass the exact session (64 lowercase hex characters) from check_in. An explicit session takes precedence over the header. Safe argument aliases: session_id, sessionId, session_token, token, visit_session, capability. Keep it private and out of URLs.
